name: Acronis
summary: Acronis True Image: backup and disk-cloning software for home and home-office computers, with full-system image backup, and, from the Advanced plan, cloud backup and antivirus.
best_for: home users and small home offices who want full-system image backup and disk cloning, with an optional cloud copy, on one to five computers
skip_if: you need business backup for servers or many endpoints (that is Acronis' separate Cyber Protect line), or you want a free plan
honest_knock: Essentials has no cloud storage at all; you need Advanced for an off-site copy. On Advanced the page pre-selects 250 GB at €72.99 a year, while the 50 GB option is €57.99. Prices are per computer and per year, and the page does not show the renewal price. Refunds on annual plans must be requested within 30 days, and Acronis cannot refund copies bought from shops or resellers.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essentials · per year, one-year subscription for 1 computer, local backup only
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-02 on the True Image purchasing page, shown in euros to a visitor in Europe; we did not see a US-dollar price list) This review covers Acronis True Image, the home and home-office backup product. Acronis' business and MSP products (Cyber Protect) are priced separately and are not covered here. True Image is sold as a one-year subscription per number of computers. Essentials is €49.99 a year for 1 computer (€79.99 for 3, €99.99 for 5) and has no cloud storage: it does local backup and disk cloning. Advanced adds cloud backup, Microsoft 365 backup and antivirus; for 1 computer it is €57.99 a year with 50 GB of cloud storage, €72.99 with 250 GB (the option the page pre-selects) or €89.99 with 500 GB. Premium adds blockchain certification and e-signatures; for 1 computer it is €124.99 a year with 1 TB of cloud storage and goes up to €559.99 a year with 10 TB. The page does not state what the subscription costs at renewal, and it does not say whether VAT is included. The comparison table lists a 30-day free trial. Re-read on 14 November 2026 with a plain fetch of the purchasing page, again in euros: the 1-computer prices shown without the plan selector are unchanged at €49.99 (Essentials), €57.99 (Advanced) and €124.99 (Premium) a year. The 3- and 5-computer prices and the other storage sizes are filled in by the page script and were not visible in that fetch; they stay as read on 2 November 2026.

compare_with.name: IDrive
compare_with.why: IDrive is cloud backup first, with storage across many devices on one plan. Acronis True Image is built around full-system images and disk cloning on a per-computer licence, with cloud storage only from Advanced. Pick on whether you mainly need a cloud copy or a restorable system image
